heroTitle:
Pay now,
sort it out later.
heroBody: On a trip, in a shared flat or out for dinner, whoever's handy pays and adds it to the group. At the end, Balnana adds everything up and tells each person who to pay and how much.
demoTitle:
Lots of bills.
Just a few transfers.
demoBody: Four friends, four expenses, each paid by someone different. Tap an expense to change the amount, who paid or how it's split, and see how the balances and transfers change.
demoNotice: Sample data. Change whatever you like.
weightedHelp: Give someone more shares if they had more, or 0 if they weren't there.
featureTitle:
Not every bill
is split evenly.
featureSplitTitle: Equally, by shares or exact amounts
featureSplitBody: Leave someone off the drinks if they didn't have any, or give the bigger room more shares of the rent. If two people paid for the same thing, you can record that too.
featureSettleBody: Balnana nets out everything the group owes each other before it suggests payments, so nobody has to pay back bill by bill.
travelTitle:
Yen, euros and dollars
in one group.
travelBody: Enter each expense in the currency you paid in, along with the exchange rate or what your card was charged. Balances are shown in the group's currency.
screenshotsNote: Screens from the Android app, in English with sample data
recurringBody: Set up rent and other regular bills once instead of adding them every month.
receiptsBody: Attach a photo of the receipt and note where you spent the money, so it's easy to find later.
liveBody: If someone adds an expense while you have the group open, it shows up straight away.
exportBody: Export your expenses to CSV, or import a group from Settle Up.
hostingTitle:
Prefer to run
your own server?
hostingBody: You can. Balnana is open source and runs with Docker Compose, with your data in PostgreSQL, and the Docs cover the setup. But if you just want to split bills with friends, we'd suggest the official server at app.balnana.com. There's nothing to install or keep up to date.
faqAccountA: You sign up on the official server to create a group. Turn on link sharing for the group, and friends can join with a private link or QR code without an account.
faqOfflineA: Mostly, on Android. You can look through cached expenses and add new expenses or payments, which upload once you're back online. Editing existing expenses and uploading receipts need a connection.
faqCurrencyA: Yes. When you pick a foreign currency, a reference rate is filled in for you. You can change it, or enter what your card was actually charged.
faqPlatformA: Android and the web. There's no iOS app yet.
faqCostA: Yes. Sign up on the official server and you can use it for free, with no ads. Balnana is also open source (AGPL-3.0).
endTitle: Want to try it with your friends?
endBody: Sign up at app.balnana.com, create a group and send everyone the link.
footerNote: Balnana is an open-source app for splitting shared expenses.
invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
donateBody: If it's made splitting bills a bit easier for your group, you can support us on Ko-fi. It helps pay for the official server and keeps the project going.
